basic_details.short_information: CSC e-Governance Services India Limited has released a recruitment notification for the post of Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District. Applications are invited for contractual engagement for a period of one year. Eligible candidates with the required qualification and Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certification can apply through the CSC Job Portal. The last date to submit the application for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026 is 27 September 2026.

qualification.details: Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications: | 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary) Matriculation + 2 Years ITI Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma | The minimum age required to apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 is 18 years. | Candidate should have Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing and Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI. Candidate should have basic computer skills.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must have any one of the following qualifications: 12th (Intermediate/Senior Secondary) Matriculation + 2 Years ITI Matriculation + 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma The minimum age required to apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator Recruitment 2026 is 18 years. Candidate should have Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a Testing and Certifying Agency authorized by UIDAI. Candidate should have basic computer skills.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Salary 2026
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive remuneration as per the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower.

content_sections.heading: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Interested candidates can apply online through the CSC Job Portal by completing the application process before the last date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the CSC Job Portal. Open the Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator recruitment notification. Check eligibility details carefully. Complete the online application form. Submit the application before 27 September 2026.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must ensure they fulfil the required eligibility conditions before applying. A valid Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate is required. Applicants should have basic computer knowledge. VLEs are not eligible to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q1. What is CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive by CSC e-Governance Services India Limited for Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District posts on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026 is 27 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the post name in CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Aadhaar Supervisor/Operator - District.

faq.question: Q4. What is the eligibility for Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates should have 12th qualification or Matriculation with 2 Years ITI or Matriculation with 3 Years Polytechnic Diploma along with required Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Jobs 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age required to apply is 18 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The remuneration will be based on the minimum wages of the respective state set for semi-skilled manpower.

faq.question: Q7. Is Aadhaar Supervisor certificate mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates should have an Aadhaar Operator/Supervisor certificate issued by a UIDAI-authorized testing and certifying agency.

faq.question: Q8. Can VLEs apply for CSC Aadhaar Supervisor Operator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. VLEs are not eligible to apply for this position.
